test_cases.test_name: Verify X-bar/R chart creation from CSV input
test_cases.objective: Ensure the system correctly generates X-bar/R charts from provided CSV data as per vendor specifications.
prerequisites: CSV file with valid QC data
User with appropriate permissions

test_steps.action: Upload a CSV file containing valid QC data to the dashboard.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts the file and displays data preview.

test_steps.action: Select X-bar/R chart option from the visualization menu.
test_steps.expected_result: System generates X-bar/R chart with correct subgroup calculations.

acceptance_criteria: X-bar/R chart is generated without errors
data_integrity_requirements: Original CSV data must remain unchanged

test_cases.test_name: Validate Nelson rules application on control charts
test_cases.objective: Confirm the system correctly applies vendor's standard Nelson rules to identify out-of-control conditions.
prerequisites: Pre-generated control chart with known violations
User with view access

test_steps.action: Load a control chart containing known Nelson rule violations.
test_steps.expected_result: Chart displays with all data points visible.

test_steps.action: Enable Nelson rules overlay from the analysis menu.
test_steps.expected_result: System highlights all expected rule violations.

acceptance_criteria: All expected Nelson rule violations are flagged
data_integrity_requirements: Underlying chart data must not be modified

test_cases.test_name: Verify X-bar/R Chart Creation from CSV Input
test_cases.objective: To ensure the system correctly creates X-bar/R charts from CSV input data as per vendor specifications.
prerequisites: CSV file with valid QC data
Access to the SPC dashboard

test_steps.action: Upload a CSV file containing QC data to the SPC dashboard.
test_steps.expected_result: The system should accept the CSV file and display a confirmation message.

test_steps.action: Select the option to create an X-bar/R chart from the uploaded data.
test_steps.expected_result: The system should generate an X-bar/R chart based on the data.

acceptance_criteria: X-bar/R chart is correctly generated from the CSV data
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure data integrity during CSV upload and chart generation
required_expertise: Basic knowledge of SPC and CSV data handling

test_cases.objective: To verify that the system can send scheduled reports via email using the vendor scheduler.
prerequisites: Configured email settings in the SPC dashboard
Scheduled report setup

test_steps.action: Set up a scheduled report to be sent via email using the vendor scheduler.
test_steps.expected_result: The system should save the scheduled report configuration.

test_steps.action: Wait for the scheduled time and check the email inbox for the report.
test_steps.expected_result: The scheduled report should be received in the email inbox.
data_to_capture: Email with the scheduled report attached

acceptance_criteria: Scheduled report is successfully sent via email at the configured time
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure data integrity during report generation and email transmission
required_expertise: Knowledge of email configuration and scheduling in SPC dashboards

test_cases.test_name: Verify CSV Import Functionality for Chart Creation
test_cases.objective: To ensure that the system correctly imports CSV data for creating X-bar/R and p-charts as specified in URS-020-001.
prerequisites: CSV file with sample QC data
Access to the SPC dashboard

test_steps.action: Upload a CSV file containing QC data to the SPC dashboard.
test_steps.expected_result: The system should successfully import the CSV file and display the data.

test_steps.action: Select the option to create an X-bar/R chart from the imported data.
test_steps.expected_result: The system should generate an X-bar/R chart based on the imported data.

data_integrity_requirements: Ensure data integrity during CSV import

test_cases.objective: To verify that the system can schedule and send report emails as specified in URS-020-006.
prerequisites: Configured email settings
Sample report

test_steps.action: Set up a scheduled email report using the vendor scheduler.
test_steps.expected_result: The system should accept the schedule and prepare the report.

test_steps.action: Wait for the scheduled time and check the email inbox.
test_steps.expected_result: The scheduled report should be received in the email inbox.

acceptance_criteria: Report is received in email inbox

test_cases.objective: To ensure the system can send scheduled reports via email using the vendor scheduler.
prerequisites: Configured email settings in the system
Scheduled report set up in the vendor scheduler

test_steps.action: Set up a scheduled report in the vendor scheduler.
test_steps.expected_result: Report is scheduled successfully.

test_steps.action: Wait for the scheduled time to elapse.
test_steps.expected_result: Email with the report is received at the specified email address.

acceptance_criteria: Email with the report is received at the scheduled time.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure the report content matches the data in the system.

test_cases.objective: To verify that the dashboard enforces role-based view access as per user roles.
prerequisites: User roles configured in the system
Test users with different roles

test_steps.action: Log in as a user with view-only access.
test_steps.expected_result: User can only view data and cannot make changes.

test_steps.action: Log in as a user with full access.
test_steps.expected_result: User can view and modify data as per their role.

acceptance_criteria: Access levels are enforced correctly based on user roles.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure no unauthorized modifications are possible.

test_cases.objective: To ensure the system correctly sends scheduled report emails using the vendor scheduler.
prerequisites: Configured email settings in the system
Scheduled report set up in the vendor scheduler

test_steps.action: Set up a scheduled report in the vendor scheduler.
test_steps.expected_result: Report is scheduled successfully without errors.

test_steps.action: Wait for the scheduled time to elapse.
test_steps.expected_result: Email with the report is received at the configured email address.

acceptance_criteria: Email with the report is received at the scheduled time.
Report content matches the expected data.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure report data is accurate and complete.

test_cases.objective: To confirm that the dashboard enforces role-based view access as per user roles.
prerequisites: User roles configured in the system
Test users with different roles

test_steps.action: Log in as a user with restricted view access.
test_steps.expected_result: User is only able to view data and charts as per their role.

test_steps.action: Log in as a user with full view access.
test_steps.expected_result: User is able to view all data and charts without restrictions.

acceptance_criteria: Users with restricted roles can only view permitted data.
Users with full access can view all data.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure data access is restricted based on user roles.
